releaseName: One button, and it is always the safe one
notes: Fixed: there were two Google Drive buttons and only one of them was safe. “Back up” replaced the copy in Drive with whatever was on the device you tapped it from — so tapping it on a device that was behind pushed the older data over the newer. There is now a single button, and it always merges first.

Fixed: the automatic backup did the same thing without being asked, so a long session on one device could bury what the other device had saved. It now merges as well, and waits rather than refreshing the screen while you are typing in a box.

Fixed a problem introduced in the previous update: after a sync, this device marked every record as if it had just been edited here. In one case that could let an untouched account outrank a genuine edit made on your other device.
